episodes.title: A Woman Named Yumeko Jabami
episodes.summary: Reigning class gambling champion Mary attempts to hustle unsuspecting transfer student Yumeko Jabami into a high-stakes game of rock-paper-scissors.

episodes.title: Boring Woman
episodes.summary: Mary is relegated to the lowest levels of the gambling hierarchy after her loss. Student board member Itsuki challenges Yumeko to a game of pairs.

episodes.title: The Slit-Eyed Woman
episodes.summary: To regain her status, Mary duels student board member Yuriko in a game of "life or death." With Mary`s crushing defeat, Yumeko offers to play next.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Became a Pet
episodes.summary: Yumeko and Mary square off against two others in a game of Indian poker after being given a chance to minimize their colossal gambling debts.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Became Human
episodes.summary: Kiwatari continues to lose as Yumeko and Mary bluff their way through the game, but the final outcome all comes down to Tsubomi.

episodes.title: Tempting Woman
episodes.summary: Yumeko must face Beautification Committee Chair Midari in an ESP card game involving Russian roulette before playing the student board president.

episodes.title: Refusing Woman
episodes.summary: Deeply engaged in their deadly ESP card game, Midari tells Yumeko about her heated match against student board president, Kirari.

episodes.title: Love-Dancing Woman
episodes.summary: In Kirari`s absence, pop idol sensation Yumemi offers to play against Yumeko, asking her to wager total control of her life.

episodes.title: Dreaming Woman
episodes.summary: With her pop idol career on the line, an enraged Yumemi seeks to ruin Yumeko after a scandalous voice recording is used as a bargaining chip.

episodes.title: Selective Woman
episodes.summary: Yumeko`s odds are stacked against her when she challenges the well-funded student board treasurer, Manyuda, in an original game of poker.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Bet Her Life
episodes.summary: Itsuki, no longer wanting to be under Manyuda`s control, offers to bankroll 100 chips after Yumeko goes all-in and loses on the previous hand.

episodes.title: Compulsive Gambling Woman
episodes.summary: Yumeko and student board president Kirari both wager self-expulsion from the academy as Ryota becomes the key to the final outcome of their game.

episodes.title: Gambling Women Again
episodes.summary: Mushibami heiress Erimi challenges Yumeko and Midari to a cruel game of chicken featuring a sadistic finger-slicing contraption.

episodes.title: The Women of Momobami Clan
episodes.summary: The Momobami clan is thrown into disarray when Kirari proclaims that the winner of the election will also take over as leader of their family.

episodes.title: This Woman is Untouchable
episodes.summary: With election committee chair Runa Yomotsuki presiding, former Vice President Ririka pits Momobami clan members Miyo and Miri against an eager Yumeko.

episodes.title: The Women Who Lead
episodes.summary: Mary, playing in place of a poisoned Yumeko, orders Ryota to show his cards, but a confident Miyo tries to convince him to keep his cards to himself.

episodes.title: The Connected Woman
episodes.summary: To gain more chips and popularity, Yumemi ropes Yumeko into forming an idol unit with her, but the entry of a true Hollywood star raises the stakes.

episodes.title: The Hollywood Woman
episodes.summary: Outperformed and outwitted by Kawaru Natari in the first round, Yumemi goes all-in for the second round, only to end up broken and vulnerable.

episodes.title: The Treacherous Woman
episodes.summary: With Kirari rapidly amassing votes, Yumeko and other top-ranking players gamble amongst themselves to either boost their chip count, or lose it all.

episodes.title: The Winning Woman
episodes.summary: Accused of betrayal, Yumeko threatens to throw the whole game -- but is she bluffing? To test Manyuda and herself, Itsuki takes a major risk.

episodes.title: The Woman on the Sidelines
episodes.summary: Livid at Yumeko, Sayaka challenges her to a game putting "everything" on the line: no chips, no election ranking, just everything they each hold dear.

episodes.title: The Logical Woman
episodes.summary: Inside the Tower of Doors, Sayaka uses logic to advance ahead, while Yumeko's curiosity and love of gambling inspires her to take an alternate route.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Bears the ⨉
episodes.summary: When a select group of contenders are invited to bid in a "100 Chip Auction," Yumeko changes the game rules by offering the unimaginable.

episodes.title: The Null Woman
episodes.summary: A vengeful Rei declares she will win the election and take over both the school and the clan itself, but Yumeko stands in her way.
